import std.io

pub type AppError = Failed(String)

pub fn main() effect io -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let n = 42
    let u: UInt64 = 7u64
    let big = 18446744073709551615u64
    let f = 0.1
    let t = true
    let c = 'A'
    let name = "we"
    io.println("n=${n}")
    io.println("u=${u} f=${f}")
    io.println("t=${t} c=${c}")
    io.println("big=${big}")
    io.println("hi ${name}!")
    io.println("${name}${n}")
    io.println("plain")
    return Ok(())
}
